maya: quick feedback loop 1 figma options: "chart-primary" (big area chart, lightweight rows, global invoice CTA) vs "ledger-primary" (dense rows with inline token chips + download icon). link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789 (screenshots attached) ryan: my immediate worry: users look for invoices in the row when they think of project-level billing. global CTA is great for org-level but discoverability for per-project invoice might drop. kevin: agree with ryan. suggestion: keep a persistent header CTA for org-level (right aligned), and add a compact kebab menu per row with "Download invoice" & "Export CSV". avoids cluttering the row. sarah: perf note inline token chips add a lot of DOM elements at 200+ rows. we should lazy-render chips and only mount for visible rows, or use canvas svg for tiny badges. i'll prototype the cost of both. lucas: copy nit: "Download invoice" vs "Get invoice PDF" vs "Export CSV". For billing novices PDF is clearer. CSV implies spreadsheet-savvy. maybe display primary as "Invoice (PDF)" and secondary under menu as "Export CSV"? maya: also visual affordance for scope: we should show a compact scope pill near the header: "Scope: Org / Project (selected)" so it's obvious what CTA will do. simple underline/breadcrumb could be too subtle. a11y-bot: accessibility report: token badges must meet 4.5:1 contrast. keyboard: row expansion must be reachable via single Tab per row. recommended pattern: role=\"button\" on the row with aria-controls pointing to the details panel and aria-expanded toggles. sample markup:
\n
Project X
\n
$1,234
\n
\n
...details & actions...
\n\nkevin: that's good. UX decision: on desktop show hover popover with quick token split + download. on mobile use accordion (pushes content). keep same actions. hover-only is not enough. ryan: analytics question: can we show which users hit per-row invoice vs header invoice? need an event shape. sarah can you estimate perf and tracking overhead? sarah: yes. perf: lazy-render + virtualization cuts DOM cost by ~80% on large org pages. tracking: one event on open/download and a property `invoice_scope: org|project` is sufficient. estimate: 2pm tomorrow for numbers. lucas: small visual idea: for high-spend rows show a subtle sparkline to the left of the label; for small spends hide it. helps scanability. make sure sparklines don't push layout. maya: decisions summary: 1) chart-primary layout for default view, 2) header/org CTA + per-row kebab menu for per-project invoice, 3) desktop hover popover + mobile accordion, 4) lazy-render token chips + virtualization for perf, 5) copy: use "Invoice (PDF)" primary and "Export CSV" secondary, 6) add visible scope pill in header. kevin: i'll update Figma with hover states + kebab menu examples today. sarah: i'll prototype lazy-render and perf numbers by tomorrow 2pm. lucas: i'll mock sparklines and spacing tweaks. ryan: i'll add event spec in the analytics doc and loop in growth. a11y-bot: accessibility checklist added to the design board. contrast tokens + keyboard focus flow required. :white_check_mark: maya: thanks everyone. i'll schedule a 20min sync after kevin's Figma update. :calendar:
